subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should Mattermost cold-thread recovery perform one bounded awaited server fetch per stored thread session and deliberately avoid retrying after a failed attempt?
rationale: Both choices are technically defensible: the current design protects steady-state availability and avoids repeated server pressure, while retrying could recover context after a transient first-attempt failure but may repeatedly delay inbound replies.

options.title: Accept bounded one-attempt recovery
options.body: Land the current policy: await one bounded fetch per stored thread session, fail open, and do not retry until the session marker changes.

options.title: Require controlled retry
options.body: Revise the helper to allow a bounded cooldown or backoff retry after transient failure, with tests proving ordinary follow-ups cannot repeatedly stall.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded one-attempt recovery
recommendation.body: Land the current policy: await one bounded fetch per stored thread session, fail open, and do not retry until the session marker changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies @mukhtharcm as the Mattermost owner, making them the best available authority for this channel-specific latency and recovery tradeoff.
